description: Add a fix to the brand's Run1Ads fix list. Pass item_key from get_today to add that finding with its steps and the number to track, or pass your own title. Writes to Run1Ads only. Nothing changes in Meta or on your store.

brand_id.description: Brand id from list_brands. Leave it out to use your most recently updated brand.

item_key.description: The key of a finding from get_today (for example vc_atc or fatigue).

pillar.description: funnel, journey, fatigue, content, audience, strategy or general.

title.description: Your own fix title, if not using item_key.

name: add_to_fix_list
